cohort: The study included 160 pregnant women undergoing an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) at 24-28 weeks of gestation, with 80 women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and 80 normal pregnant women serving as controls.
finding: The study found that 13.75% of GDM women had subclinical hypothyroidism and 6.25% had maternal hypothyroxinaemia, suggesting that women with GDM are at high risk for hypothyroidism, with no significant difference in thyroglobulin antibodies between GDM and control groups.
